John 4:35: You think the harvest is months off — Jesus says look again, it's ready NOW · the person you've been waiting to 'be ready' might already be · open your eyes to it
John 6:12: After feeding thousands, Jesus says gather the leftovers so nothing's wasted · the God of abundance still cares about the fragments · He doesn't waste anything, including the broken pieces of you
John 9:31: God listens to the one who worships Him and does His will · a heart bent toward Him gets heard · it's not about fancy words, it's about whose you are when you pray
Mark 4:24: The measure you give out is the measure you get back · pour out generously — attention, grace, time — and it comes back to you in kind · stingy gets stingy
Psalm 95:1: Come on, let's sing to the Lord and make a joyful noise to our Rock · worship was never meant to be stiff · He's solid enough to celebrate loud
Psalm 145:1: 'I'll lift You up, my God and King, and bless Your name forever' · worship that has no end date · He's not a phase you grow out of, He's a forever you grow into
